kills.note: Judge-seeded faults only. This card's judge seeded 14 faults of its own into a COPY of the packet and ran all three suites against each (42 suite runs). No catalogue from the repository was read or run.

determinism.detail: All three suites run three times each on the unmutated copy: 28 / 28 / 14 passed every time, same counts, no ordering or tmp_path sensitivity observed.

reach.note: Print reach beside every kill: executed of emitted, per instrument, per action, with the skip rule named.
reach.measured: Reach is total for this packet and there is no skip rule: no case in either suite is skipped, xfailed or conditionally collected, so executed == emitted for every instrument (28/28, 28/28, 14/14). The one conditional in the packet is TestDurableRecord's parametrisation over DURABLE_ADAPTERS (tests/test_journal_conformance.py:114), which EMITS 4 cases rather than 8 -- the fake is excluded at collection, not skipped at run time, and tests/test_journal_conformance.py:216-232 covers the fake's side of that clause instead.
